summary: Frontend-only i18n verification for COSMIC HORA — tested English/Hindi/Telugu across Home, Reports (15 cards), Birth form, Auth pages, Dashboard, and 7 static pages. All translation flows work correctly with no i18n-related console errors. Backend suite skipped per main agent's instructions (no backend changes this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: i18n.jsx dictionaries (~586 lines) are large but readable; consider splitting per-locale files (en.js/hi.js/te.js) if more languages get added.
tReport() in i18n.jsx calls t() twice per field; harmless but a small perf micro-opt available by storing raw once and comparing.
Legal pages (/privacy /terms /refund), Blog post content, FAQ Q&A, and Admin console intentionally remain English — this is documented as by-design in scope and confirmed working.
Fallback behavior (missing HI/TE key → EN) verified: no visible English fallback observed on Home/Reports/Birth/Auth/Dashboard/static pages in HI or TE.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@cosmichora.com / Admin@Cosmic2026 (verified working, redirects to /admin)
seed_data_creation: Created 1 throwaway registered user (test_i18n_<timestamp>@example.com / TestPass@123) to exercise Dashboard localization.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 had 29/29 backend tests passing (see /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py). Iteration 2 is UI-only i18n. LangSwitch data-testids: lang-switch-btn + lang-option-en/hi/te. Login inputs are login-email-input / login-password-input (not login-email). Register: register-name-input, register-email-input, register-password-input, register-submit-btn. Report cards use data-testid='report-card-<slug>'. html[lang] attribute set via useEffect in i18n.jsx. Console shows two 401s on load from /api/auth/me — this is the AuthProvider bootstrapping when no session, unrelated to i18n and expected.

detailed_verifications.console_errors_note: Only two /api/auth/me 401s during AuthProvider bootstrap when no session — unrelated to i18n; expected.
